A '''spear''' is the vanilla charging weapon, given pack stats and, for alloys, intrinsics. Steel spears add knockback, the hepatizon spear has Lunge III and speed, the shakudo spear steals life, the electrum spear has Smite IV, Looting II and {{G|Warding}} 2, and the adamant spear inflicts Weakness.

{{Data/Weapons/Spear}}

The electrum and adamant spears carry no attack speed modifier matching their tooltips (1.18 and 0.95): the electrum spear's real attack speed is 4 and the adamant spear keeps the vanilla netherite spear's attributes (5 damage, 0.87).<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/smithing/electrum_spear.json}}</ref>
